title: A Flicker in the Bones
description: The cold blue soul-light flickers as you pass through a bone-lined alcove. A translucent figure materializes — a woman in scholar's robes, her form wavering like a candle in wind. 'You can see me? Then you carry something of the living world strong enough to pierce this half-death. I am Lira. I was... a scholar of the Crown.'

choices.label: Listen to her story
choices.description: Take time to hear what Lira has learned about the Necropolis and its King.

outcomes.text: Lira's voice strengthens as you listen. 'The Ossuary King is not the source — he is a puppet. Something deeper pulls the strings. I mapped the connection before I... fell. Take my notes. They show how to reach the Void Threshold beyond the final region.'

As Lira speaks, the Ossuary King's presence presses in. The soul-light dims and Lira's form wavers. 'He knows I'm speaking to you. Hurry — take what knowledge I can give. The King's weakness is his crown: shatter it and his hold on the dead breaks.'

choices.label: Use a crystal to anchor her
choices.description: Attempt to use a fragment of crystal to stabilize Lira's spirit.

outcomes.text: The crystal pulses as it touches Lira's hand. Her form solidifies, color returning to her cheeks in memory if not in truth. 'Remarkable. I can feel the living world again. I'll guide your steps — there are secrets in these halls the King doesn't want found.'
The crystal cracks under the strain of anchoring a spirit in the Necropolis. Lira's form stabilizes briefly. 'It won't hold long, but it's enough. I'll share what I know while I can.'
